serialKiller.modeDuoMeta: Taking turns, or each on your own phone
serialKiller.relaisDebut: Answer the whole series, then pass the phone.
serialKiller.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
serialKiller.jaugesTitre: What stands out in your answers
serialKiller.modesDesc: The fifteen questions are the same. Solo, you find out which killer you're most like. As a couple, each of you answers separately and you compare your two portraits.
serialKiller.modeDuoDesc: Taking turns on the same phone, or each on your own with remote mode.
serialKiller.setupTitreSolo: Which serial killer are you compatible with?
serialKiller.setupDescSolo: Fifteen questions about how you love, how you lie and how you keep your apartment. Answer honestly: the portrait you get is the one that looks most like you, blown way out of proportion.
serialKiller.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first player answers the fifteen questions, passes the phone, and the second answers in turn. Both portraits show up at the end, side by side.
serialKiller.avertissement: A Halloween quiz, just for fun: it only talks about character traits, exaggerated to the point of caricature.
serialKiller.memePortrait: The same killer for both of you: run away together, or stay together, your call.
serialKiller.portraitsDifferents: Two different killers: at least you won't be competing.
serialKiller.noteFin: This quiz is a Halloween game. The people named here had real victims; this only talks about character traits, exaggerated to the point of caricature.
serialKiller.p_bundy_d: The easy smile, the line that puts everyone at ease, the perfect-son-in-law look. Like him, you know people trust you within two minutes, and you use it. People follow you without quite knowing why, and they realise it afterwards.
serialKiller.p_bundy_a: On Halloween night, you're the one who opens the door to the kids: the costume changes nothing, they'll hand you their candy.
serialKiller.p_dahmer_d: You struggle to let people go, you keep everything, you prefer your apartment to the rest of the world. When you like someone, you'd want them to never leave again. In your case, that means hugs that last too long and a lot of “stay a little longer”.
serialKiller.p_dahmer_a: For Halloween, invite people over, but leave the door open. And sort through your collections, it'll reassure the guests.
serialKiller.p_ripper_d: Nobody really knows who you are, and you like it that way. You walk at night, you say little, you remember everything, and your childhood friends couldn't tell you what you do with your weekends. A hundred and thirty years later, they're still looking for him.
serialKiller.p_ripper_a: The ideal Halloween costume: top hat, long coat, and you tell no one where you're going after the party.
serialKiller.p_zodiac_d: You love being hunted. Codes, riddles, letters with double meanings, clues left on purpose: you can't help toying with the people trying to understand you. And you'd hate to be forgotten.
serialKiller.p_zodiac_a: At Halloween, you're the one organising the treasure hunt. But promise to give the solution before midnight, this time.
serialKiller.p_manson_d: You do nothing yourself: you talk, you convince, and the others end up thinking like you without noticing. In a group, you're the one who decides, even when everyone believes they chose.
serialKiller.p_manson_a: For Halloween, you're the person who picks the movie, the costume and the time. At least let the others pick the candy.
serialKiller.p_btk_d: Family, job, neighbours who wave at you: your life looks so normal that nobody would think of looking behind it. You're patient, methodical, and you keep your secrets in neatly organised binders. Thirty years without anyone suspecting a thing.
serialKiller.p_btk_a: Your house will be the best decorated on the street for Halloween, perfectly symmetrical. Nobody will ask questions, as usual.
serialKiller.p_wuornos_d: You have the survival instinct of people who've taken too many hits. You get angry fast, you love hard, you slam the door on your way out and you come back. With you, nothing is calculated: everything is reaction.
serialKiller.p_wuornos_a: On Halloween night, avoid haunted houses where people jump out at you: the first one who scares you will regret it.
serialKiller.p_holmes_d: You build, you plan, you make money out of everything, and your house always has one more room than planned. An elegant swindler, a friendly pillar of the community, and a plan behind every smile.
serialKiller.p_holmes_a: For Halloween, don't offer to show people around your house. Especially not the basement.
serialKiller.q1: First meeting at a party: how do you approach someone you like?
serialKiller.q1a: I walk up with a smile and a ready-made excuse, it works every time
serialKiller.q1b: I stay in my corner and wait for them to come talk to me
serialKiller.q1c: I drop a strange, slightly coded remark to see if they get it
serialKiller.q1d: I do nothing, I watch and remember everything
serialKiller.q2a: Spotless, everything in its place, nobody touches anything
serialKiller.q2b: Full of things I keep “just in case”
serialKiller.q2c: Permanently under construction: I'm always adding a room or a shelf
serialKiller.q2d: I never stay long enough to look after it
serialKiller.q3: Your partner read your messages without telling you. You...
serialKiller.q3a: I take it with a smile and turn the situation to my advantage
serialKiller.q3b: I explode, then feel bad about it an hour later
serialKiller.q3c: I say nothing, but I change all my passwords and write down the date
serialKiller.q3d: I calmly explain why they're the one in the wrong, until they apologise
serialKiller.q4: A free weekend, nobody around. What's the plan?
serialKiller.q4a: A puzzle, crosswords, a treasure hunt I'm setting up for someone
serialKiller.q4b: DIY: I take apart, rebuild, perfect
serialKiller.q4c: I walk around the city at night, no destination, I like the fog
serialKiller.q4d: I stay home with my collections and my series
serialKiller.q5: In a group of friends, you're...
serialKiller.q5a: The person who ends up deciding for everyone without anyone noticing
serialKiller.q5b: The quiet pillar: family, job, volunteering, nobody suspects a thing
serialKiller.q5c: The loose cannon who gets angry fast and slams the door
serialKiller.q5d: The one everyone's known for ten years without knowing anything about their life
serialKiller.q6a: I lie well, with confidence, and it almost makes me laugh
serialKiller.q6b: I don't lie, I just keep a separate life nobody sees
serialKiller.q6c: I prefer hints and riddles: let the other person figure it out
serialKiller.q6d: I only lie for money, and only if it pays big
serialKiller.q7b: Being forgotten, nobody talking about me anymore
serialKiller.q7c: Someone finding out who I really am
serialKiller.q7d: Nothing, I've been scared enough in my life
serialKiller.q8: You're making dinner for someone. You...
serialKiller.q8a: I work on the staging: candles, music, a little speech
serialKiller.q8b: I cook for two and secretly hope they'll stay the night, and the next day too
serialKiller.q8c: I build a multi-course menu, each dish hidden behind a door
serialKiller.q8d: I order in, and spend the evening listening to them tell their life story
serialKiller.q9: An anonymous letter arrives at your place. Your first reaction?
serialKiller.q9a: I decode it, I look for the pattern, I love it
serialKiller.q9b: I burn it and watch the street all night
serialKiller.q9c: I file it in a binder, with the others
serialKiller.q9d: I show it to everyone laughing, and find the author within two days
serialKiller.q10a: Ironed shirt, matching smile, the perfect-son-in-law look
serialKiller.q10b: Long coat, collar up, hat if possible
serialKiller.q10c: Whatever's clean in the wardrobe, I don't look
serialKiller.q10d: A notable's suit, an expensive watch and a smart address
serialKiller.q11: A friend tells you a huge secret. You...
serialKiller.q11a: I keep it, and use it later, at the right moment
serialKiller.q11b: I keep it and will never tell anyone, whatever happens
serialKiller.q11c: I keep it, but I leave clues to see if anyone guesses
serialKiller.q11d: I keep it in my head with all the others, I collect them
serialKiller.q12: Your greatest quality, in your opinion:
serialKiller.q12a: My charm: people trust me within two minutes
serialKiller.q12b: My patience: I can wait for years
serialKiller.q12c: My business sense: I can make money out of anything
serialKiller.q12d: My survival instinct: I always get through
serialKiller.q13: In a relationship, your way of loving:
serialKiller.q13a: Intense and exclusive: I'd want the other person to never go out again
serialKiller.q13b: All-enveloping: I talk, I convince, and they end up thinking like me
serialKiller.q13c: Discreet: I show nothing, but I know everything
serialKiller.q13d: Explosive: passion on Monday, fight on Tuesday
serialKiller.q14: A stranger recognises you in the street and asks if you're “that person”. You...
serialKiller.q14a: I deny it with a big smile, then invite them for a drink
serialKiller.q14b: I disappear into the crowd without answering
serialKiller.q14d: I sell them something before they have time to realise
serialKiller.q15: If you had to leave a mark on history...
serialKiller.q15b: An empire built with my own hands
serialKiller.q15c: A family that never suspected a thing
serialKiller.q15d: People who still follow me everywhere, today
